topics.title: Audio booth rehearsal booking
topics.rule: Audio booth rehearsal booking concerns community audio booth sessions. This ordinary service requires approval from a studio coordinator. The permitted duration is 90 minutes. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Audio booth rehearsal booking, the applicant must attach a session code and equipment checklist. Keep that record in the SoundRoom register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Commercial Recording Booking
topics.rule: Commercial Recording Booking concerns community audio booth sessions. This restricted service requires approval from a licensing coordinator. The permitted duration is 6 hours. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Commercial Recording Booking, the applicant must attach a session code and equipment checklist. Keep that record in the SoundRoom register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Fabric workshop tool borrowing
topics.rule: Fabric workshop tool borrowing concerns fictional textile workshop tools. This ordinary service requires approval from a workshop custodian. The permitted duration is 3 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Fabric workshop tool borrowing, the applicant must attach a tool serial and return inspection. Keep that record in the WeaveDesk register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Industrial Cutting Equipment Borrowing
topics.rule: Industrial Cutting Equipment Borrowing concerns fictional textile workshop tools. This restricted service requires approval from a machinery supervisor. The permitted duration is 12 hours. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Industrial Cutting Equipment Borrowing, the applicant must attach a tool serial and return inspection. Keep that record in the WeaveDesk register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Wetland survey ordinary access
topics.rule: Wetland survey ordinary access concerns fictional wetland survey visits. This ordinary service requires approval from a habitat steward. The permitted duration is 5 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Wetland survey ordinary access, the applicant must attach a team roster and visit log. Keep that record in the MarshGate register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Protected Nesting Area Access
topics.rule: Protected Nesting Area Access concerns fictional wetland survey visits. This restricted service requires approval from a wildlife coordinator. The permitted duration is 20 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Protected Nesting Area Access, the applicant must attach a team roster and visit log. Keep that record in the MarshGate register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Satellite classroom lesson archive
topics.rule: Satellite classroom lesson archive concerns fictional classroom lesson archives. This ordinary service requires approval from a course librarian. The permitted duration is 60 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Satellite classroom lesson archive, the applicant must attach a lesson identifier and consent reference. Keep that record in the LessonVault register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Public Lesson Distribution
topics.rule: Public Lesson Distribution concerns fictional classroom lesson archives. This restricted service requires approval from a copyright reviewer. The permitted duration is 180 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Public Lesson Distribution, the applicant must attach a lesson identifier and consent reference. Keep that record in the LessonVault register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.
